notes.title: Dev Log / Patch Notes: Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello Zone 13 players!

We’ve rolled out a new patch (because the devs have finally finished getting the achievements in Wukong), and we’re excited to share some updates and fixes that will enhance your experience. Thank you all for your feedback, and as always, we’re committed to delivering the best, most immersive gameplay possible!

Patch Notes:

Bug Fixes:

Tutorial Text Issues (Localization Fixes): We’ve addressed some bugs related to tutorial text when using languages other than English. The text should now display properly across all supported languages.
Ghost Girl Sound Issue: Fixed a bug where the sound related to the ghost girl anomaly would repeat incorrectly. The audio cues for this anomaly should now work as intended.


Gameplay Improvements:

Increased Anomaly Generation: We adjusted the anomaly generation algorithm to make your experience even more chilling. The resulting experience should be more consistent, with fewer lulls between events.
Playable Space Tweaks: We’ve adjusted some collisions and removed a particularly noticeable invisible wall. You can now enter the cells and go up the previously inaccessible staircases, opening up more areas to make the map feel more organic. Beware—there might be something lurking in these new spaces!



News & Updates:

🚨 Development of Map 2 Has Begun! 🚨
We’re thrilled to announce that we’ve officially started development on Map 2! This new map will introduce fresh, eerie environments with even more terrifying anomalies to uncover. Stay tuned for sneak peeks and updates on its progress.

Thank you for all your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the new patch! Be sure to share your feedback—we’d love to hear how these changes impact your journey through Zone 13!

A Big Thank You to Our Players

We want to extend a massive thank you to everyone who has played and supported Zone 13 so far! Your feedback, gameplay streams, and reviews have been invaluable in shaping the game and pushing it to the next level. We couldn’t have made it this far without you, and we’re thrilled to continue this journey together as we develop even more content for you to enjoy.

As always, keep the feedback coming, and we’ll see you in the shadows of Zone 13. 


Until next time! 👻 (You Is Win!)
— The Zone 13 Dev Team
